_note: Synthetic Domo tenant DataSet census (fictional company 'Northwind Manufacturing'), shaped after Domo's PUBLIC DataSet API (GET /v1/datasets). Public fields only: id, name, description, rows, columns, owner, dataCurrentAt, createdAt, updatedAt, pdpEnabled. `_source_system` and `_governance` are NOT public API fields — they are enrichment inferred during assessment (pre-tagged here so the fixture is self-describing). Column types use Domo's set: STRING|LONG|DECIMAL|DOUBLE|DATE|DATETIME. All names/companies are fictional.
